§6Schrabidium Cluster§f

§aConcentrate schrabidium into dense blocks. These are your ticket to euphemium.§f

§bSchrabidium Clusters§f are crafted blocks made from §bStarmetal§f, §bSchrabidium§f, and §bFerric Schrabidate§f. The recipe goes:

Schrabidium + Starmetal + Schrabidium
Starmetal + Ferric Schrabidate + Starmetal
Schrabidium + Starmetal + Schrabidium

Each cluster needs starmetal (from the cyclotron), schrabidium (from any production method), and ferric schrabidate (requires a fusion reactor and chemical processing). The ferric schrabidate is usually the bottleneck, so keep your fusion reactor running.

§6What they're for§f: Place clusters around a balefire bomb, detonate, and the ones touched by balefire become §bEuphemium-Etched Schrabidium Clusters§f. Centrifuge those for euphemium nuggets. Each cluster is expensive, and you need multiple for a meaningful yield.

§ePS:§f Build a big batch before attempting euphemium production. Clusters are immune to all nukes, even the Tsar Bomba, so you can safely detonate without destroying them.
